01 / Project overview

A technical catalog needs a clear way in.

A B Pal Electricals (P) Limited is an electrical solutions provider in India specializing in the safe and dependable transmission of electric power. Its wide range of technical products called for a structured digital presence that would make exploration intuitive while reinforcing credibility and trust.

Working within a design agency, I led the UX and interface design process from stakeholder discovery through high-fidelity prototypes and production-ready interface specifications. I collaborated with brand stakeholders and frontend developers to connect the business requirements with a practical web experience.

02 / Stakeholder discovery

Translate business complexity into visitor priorities.

Regular stakeholder meetings helped clarify the product range, business requirements, and information visitors needed to explore the offering. These discussions translated dense business language and technical specifications into structured user flows and digestible content hierarchies.

  • Core product verticals
  • Business priorities
  • Key conversion goals
  • Target audience
  • Content depth requirements
The insight that shaped the direction

Credibility and clarity mattered more than visual experimentation. The experience needed to help visitors find information efficiently and trust what they were seeing.

03 / Information architecture

Help people recognize the right category.

The central information challenge was making an extensive product range manageable. A structured taxonomy grouped related offerings, while modular layouts gave each category a predictable presentation. Clear category entry points helped visitors move from the homepage into product exploration.

04 / Wireframing & user touchpoints

Resolve structure before adding visual detail.

I created low-fidelity wireframes to work through navigation depth, category structures, and content priority. Mapping the path from the homepage to product exploration helped identify how page sections and entry points should connect before the interface was developed in detail.

The wireframes established the content structure for the high-fidelity design, keeping attention on a clear route through the product information.

05 / Interface design

Make dense information easier to scan.

A restrained visual language supported the credibility of a technical business. Consistent interface standards, clear hierarchy, and modular content layouts organized product information into a professional, readable experience.

The design balances business identity with practical use: recognizable product categories, repeatable page patterns, and clear calls to action support exploration without unnecessary visual complexity.

06 / Design system

Build reusable parts for a growing product range.

I developed a component-based interface system in Figma to support consistency across the website. Reusable navigation, controls, and page elements provided a shared foundation for the product range and its responsive layouts.

Documented interface components and color choices helped connect the high-fidelity prototypes with production-ready specifications for the development team.

07 / Delivery & collaboration

Carry the design through to implementation.

Continuous collaboration with stakeholders and frontend developers helped align the design with real-world implementation constraints. The delivery focused on responsive behavior, consistent interface standards, and performance-aware UI implementation.

The live website brings the structured navigation, modular layouts, and component system together in a production experience.

08 / Challenges & solutions

Turn constraints into a clearer experience.

Dense product information

Response: A structured taxonomy and modular layouts make the extensive range easier to organize and navigate.

Trust in a technical domain

Response: Restrained visual styling and consistent interface standards reinforce the brand’s professional character.

Real-world delivery constraints

Response: Ongoing stakeholder and developer collaboration keeps the interface aligned with implementation needs.

Outcome / What changed

A product-heavy business became a navigable digital experience.

The final solution brings an extensive product range into a structured, professional website. The delivered experience combines:

  • Structured navigation across extensive product categories.
  • A clear, professional interface suited to a technical business.
  • Responsive behavior across devices.
  • A scalable component system for consistent page design.
  • Performance-aware implementation developed in collaboration with the frontend team.

Results across my work

Reported results include a 56% improvement in usability and task completion, along with increased site engagement.
